detail: Decisions: Don't distinguish merged-and-deleted from force-deleted branches — once gone, the action (archive entries from it) is the same.; Snapshot file lives at .twining/.last-known-branches.json — consistent with the .last-record pattern; gitignored.; First-run is a no-op for archival — records initial snapshot, returns initial_record=true. Avoids spurious deletions on first install.
summary: PR B (Phase 4 of #7): twining_housekeeping merge_sweep flag — diff branches against .twining/.last-known-branches.json, flag entries provenance-stamped with deleted branches.
